name: Flarepib
description: Flarepib’s throat sac glows like a dim lantern when it exhales warm air. It uses rhythmic croaks to generate sparks, keeping predators at bay.
appearance: Small, red-orange tadpole with amber eyes and a translucent belly that flickers like a candle flame. Its back features three nub-like heat vents that puff out steam when it hops.

name: Lumacroak
description: Lumacroak’s skin patterns absorb sunlight during the day and release it at night in the form of glowing streaks. It’s known to lead travelers out of jungles after dusk.
appearance: A bipedal frog with smooth, copper-colored skin and luminous linear markings across its limbs. Its throat sac is crystalline and pulses with light in time with its heartbeat.

name: Solamphibos
description: Said to embody dawn itself, Solamphibos releases purifying fire that cleanses toxicity from wetlands. Its croak echoes like singing bells, bringing calm wherever it roams.
appearance: Elegant amphibian with golden-white skin, sun motifs across its arms and back, and gently glowing eyes. It stands tall like a sage, radiating warmth and light in soft pulses.

name: Verdreep
description: Verdreep hides in seaweed beds, pretending to be part of the kelp. It uses sticky vines to anchor itself against strong ocean currents.
appearance: Otter-like hollowing wrapped in green-brown seaweed fur, with small leaf-like ears and curious blue eyes. Bubbles constantly trail from its paws.

name: Phantotter
description: After shedding its mortal seaweed pelt, the spirit of the ocean claims it. Phantotter manipulates drifting kelp ghosts to mislead ships.
appearance: Translucent green otter with faint spectral ripples flowing along its body. Its tail splits into ethereal strands resembling water plants waving in unseen tides.

name: Abyreedon
description: Legends say Abyreedon guards drowned forests where spirits of lost sailors rest. It sings in haunting tones that cause wilting flowers to bloom one last time.
appearance: Majestic, kelp-cloaked otter with a ghostly pale chest and bright emerald flames drifting between its paws. Its eyes resemble glowing pools of deep water.

name: Rivanos
description: Rivanos loves testing its strength by headbutting coral and splashing the debris around. It’s playful but stubborn.
appearance: A small blue dinosaur hatchling with a domed skull and bright white snout. Tiny fins line the sides of its tail, aiding fast swimming.

name: Terrinoir
description: Terrinoir’s skull is harder than granite. It uses it to carve underwater tunnels — sometimes as homes for smaller Pokémon...
appearance: Grey-blue reptile with tough plating over its back and a sleek body. Its horns start to curve backward, decorated with algae-like streaks from deep-water battles.

name: Duskuragon
description: Duskuragon dominates the coastal abyss, ramming intruders with terrifying precision. Its body is wrapped in shadowy currents said to swallow light itself.
appearance: Massive dinosaur-like hollowing with pitch-black horns, deep cerulean scales, and a faint dark shimmer. Its skull glows faintly blue from inner energy, like light seen through deep water.

name: Pupawn
description: Pupawn is a timid puppy who dreams of becoming a guardian worthy of the elements. Its spirit changes when it forges a bond with one of nature's cores, molding its destiny into a fearsome beast.
appearance: A small beige puppy with soft fur. Its eyes glimmer faintly, sometimes shifting hue in correspondence with unseen elemental forces.
evolution_mechanic: Evolves when bonded with elemental essence corresponding to a type or dual-type fusion stone.

name: Ignisrael
description: Forged in searing flame, Ignisrael burns with unmatched pride. When its howl echoes across mountains, even volcanoes answer. Known as the Sovereign Flame Hound, it embodies passion, destruction, and loyalty.
appearance: A tall wolf with a crimson-gold mane of living fire, obsidian horns, and dark ash streaks along its legs. Flames leak from deep cracks in its fur.

name: Torrentis
description: Born from tidal storms, Torrentis patrols the oceans as a silent warden. When angered, whirlpools form in its wake. Its howl can calm the waves or tear ships apart.
appearance: Streamlined blue wolf with a sleek fin mane. Its paws leave rippling water trails on the ground.

name: Verdama
description: Verdama dwells in ancient groves, its fur covered in flowering vines. When it howls, entire forests bloom in response. It is the guardian of balance in the wild.
appearance: A moss-green wolf with leaves sprouting from its back and tail. Small flowers illuminate its path at night.

name: Runaris
description: Runaris embodies adaptability. Its fur shimmers with subtle patterns resembling ancient runes. It channels the aura of all elements without truly belonging to any.
appearance: A silver-gray wolf with multicolored runic etchings flowing across its body like living lines of code.

name: Noctyros
description: Noctyros stalks moonless nights, blending perfectly into shadow. Its breath steals warmth and light, leaving behind silence and dread. Feared as the omen of the eclipsed moon.
appearance: A sleek black wolf with violet eyes and shadow-striped fur that seems to absorb light.

name: Solarune
description: Solarune is a radiant guardian said to appear when dawn breaks after long wars. Its light erases corruption, and its howl heals the hearts of those nearby.
appearance: Golden-white wolf wreathed in faint halo light. Its eyes burn like tiny suns.

name: Gravulor
description: Gravulor’s steps shake the soil and awaken mountains. It builds dens in rocky caverns and protects them with natural barriers of stone and dust.
appearance: Massive earth-toned wolf with thick armor plates and crystal claws.

name: Wraithound
description: Wraithound drifts at the boundary between life and death. Many believe it guides lost spirits to the afterlife, though its chilling eyes see both worlds at once.
appearance: A translucent wolf whose body flickers like fading smoke. Its howl echoes as overlapping whispers.

name: Tempestral
description: Tempestral races through storms faster than wind can chase its tail. Its mere passing births tornados; its presence clears the air itself.
appearance: Feathered wolf with wispy wings of vapor and lightning eyes. Its paws barely touch the ground.

name: Cryovelis
description: Born of glacial storms, Cryovelis howls across frozen plains. Though beautiful, its touch can halt hearts in an instant.
appearance: Pale-blue fur shimmering with frost. Its breath releases snowflakes, and its eyes glow like frozen moons.

name: Voltalis
description: Voltalis runs faster than thunder and can turn entire fields into lightning webs. It stores energy in its fur for devastating discharges.
appearance: A wolf of bright yellow fur streaked with jagged black patterns. Its tail sparks constantly.

name: Venomaris
description: Venomaris prowls swamps veiled in haze, its breath a miasma that wilts metal and bone alike. It strikes swiftly, letting poison finish what its fangs begin.
appearance: A dark violet wolf with green luminescent veins pulsing under translucent skin. Toxic fumes trail from its snarling jaws.

name: Ferronyx
description: Ferronyx’s body is forged from living steel. It guards ancient ruins, its roar echoing like clashing blades. Even legends hesitate to strike it head‑on.
appearance: A metallic wolf whose silver armor plates shift like interlocking gears. Its claws leave sparks with every step.

name: Eclipsera
description: Eclipsera embodies the meeting of radiance and void. Its howl signals balance between creation and decay. For a fleeting instant, shadows and light obey its call.
appearance: Half its body shines with golden fur, the other half draped in shifting shadow. A thin halo and dark crescent orbit above its head.

name: Pipereef
description: Pipereef hides in tidepools and blows tiny bubble rings that confuse predators. It collects shiny shell bits and uses them as decoys.
appearance: A marble-sized sea slug with a fin-like crest and bead-black eyes. Its back has two reed-like siphons that whistle softly when it swims.

name: Reedmollusk
description: Reedmollusk’s twin siphons can blast water like a jet and vent mist to glide briefly. It plays a low, flute-like note to call its shoal.
appearance: A sleek, palm-length mollusk with wing-shaped fins and two long siphons like reeds. Its shell fragments form a collar that rattles when it accelerates.

name: Nibbkit
description: Nibbkit hoards crumbs and lost buttons in hidden pockets of fur. When startled, it freezes so perfectly it can pass for a plush toy.
appearance: A kitten-like hollowing with oversized paws and a stitched-looking fur pattern. Its tail ends in a little puff shaped like a pom-pom.

name: Purlarcen
description: Purlarcen stalks by padding on its own shadow, making no sound. It’s famous for returning stolen items—if you leave a better trade.
appearance: A sleek cat with a mask-like face marking and a long ribbon tail that seems to fade at the tip. Its whiskers glitter like fine wire.

name: Twigglo
description: Twigglo stores sunlight in its sap like a lantern. It helps lost travelers by leaving glowing droplets along safe paths.
appearance: A tiny stick-sprite with a bud for a head and a leaf-cape. Its chest has a bead of resin that pulses softly at dusk.

name: Brambright
description: Brambright’s thorns refract light into dazzling patterns that disorient foes. It can heal minor wounds by brushing them with warm sap.
appearance: A bramble-bodied sprite with a crown of glowing buds. Its arms end in thorny fans that shimmer like stained glass.

name: Solbriar
description: Solbriar is said to ‘bloom’ only when it has protected a whole grove. Its radiant thorns can cut through gloom and cleanse poisoned soil.
appearance: A tall briar guardian with vine armor and a sunburst halo of petals. Golden resin runs in lines like veins across its limbs.

name: Mitelet
description: Mitelet digs tiny tunnels under compost piles and releases a mild toxin that speeds up decay. Gardens with one are strangely fertile.
appearance: A pill-bug larva with a dirt-caked shell and two violet feelers. It rolls into a pebble-sized ball when threatened.

name: Caraphex
description: Caraphex compresses toxins into crystal nodules along its armor. It can fling these nodules to mark territory and deter larger monsters.
appearance: A plated burrower with hexagon segments and purple crystal studs. Its foreclaws are spade-shaped and constantly drip dark sap.

name: Cindlark
description: Cindlark rides warm updrafts over chimneys and snatches stray sparks mid-flight. Its feathers stay cool, but its breath is scorching.
appearance: A small charcoal-gray bird with ember-red wing tips. Its chest has a faint glow like a banked coal, brightening when it sings.

name: Pyrocor
description: Pyrocor fans wildfires away from nests by carving clean wind corridors. It’s revered as a ‘smoke-shear’ guardian during dry seasons.
appearance: A hawk-like bird with broad wings that look dusted in ash. Its tail feathers burn in a controlled arc, leaving a brief ribbon of heat haze.

name: Noxling
description: Noxling lurks in unlit corners and ‘drinks’ the silence there. It isn’t malicious—just curious about fear and how it changes people.
appearance: A small shadow-hollowing with a candle-wick tail and pale dot eyes. Its body looks like folded cloth made of night.

name: Ferrimaw
description: Ferrimaw patrols scrapyards and ‘locks’ onto intruders with a magnetic snap. It chews iron slowly to sharpen its jaw plates.
appearance: A squat junkyard monster with riveted jaw armor and magnet-like horns. Its forearms end in clamp claws with worn serrations.

name: Niblet
description: Niblet gnaws on anything it can find to keep its ever-growing teeth filed down. Its whiskers can sense vibrations from predators approaching.
appearance: A tiny, round rodent with oversized front teeth, soft beige fur, and twitchy pink ears. Its tail is short and fluffy like a cotton ball.

name: Gnawer
description: Gnawer can chew through solid wood in seconds. Colonies of Gnawer have been known to topple entire forests when food is scarce.
appearance: A stocky, aggressive-looking rodent with powerful jaws and dark brown fur. Scars mark its face from territorial battles, and its claws are thick and curved.

name: Puddlop
description: Puddlop forms in shallow puddles after rainstorms. Its body is 95% water, allowing it to squeeze through the tiniest cracks.
appearance: A translucent blue blob with two dark circular eyes floating inside. Small ripples constantly move across its gelatinous surface.

name: Sparkbug
description: Sparkbug generates static electricity by rubbing its wing cases together. It's attracted to electronics and often causes power outages.
appearance: A small beetle with a bright yellow carapace marked with black lightning bolt patterns. Its antennae crackle with tiny arcs of electricity.

name: Voltbeetle
description: Voltbeetle's horn acts as a lightning rod, storing massive amounts of electrical energy. It can power a small village for a week with one discharge.
appearance: A large rhinoceros beetle with a metallic blue-black shell and a glowing yellow horn. Electricity visibly arcs between its mandibles.

name: Peblit
description: Peblit rolls down hillsides to build momentum and escape danger. The minerals in its body determine its coloration.
appearance: A small, round stone hollowing with stubby legs and curious pebble eyes. Cracks in its surface reveal a faint orange glow from its molten core.

name: Boulrock
description: Boulrock's body has hardened into dense granite. It guards mountain passes and will not move for anything short of an earthquake.
appearance: A boulder-shaped hollowing with thick rocky limbs and glowing orange veins running through its body. Its face is stern and weathered.

name: Terramight
description: Terramight's core burns at over 2000 degrees. Ancient civilizations worshipped it as a mountain god, and its footsteps register on seismographs miles away.
appearance: A massive humanoid golem with a body of dark stone reinforced with metallic ore veins. Magma glows through cracks in its chest, and its eyes burn like furnaces.

name: Frostling
description: Frostling is the spirit of a hollowing that perished in a blizzard. It seeks warmth but accidentally freezes anything it touches.
appearance: A small, wispy white spirit with icy blue eyes and frost crystals forming its translucent body. A sad expression is frozen on its face.

name: Venomite
description: Venomite spreads disease wherever it flies. Its buzzing wings disperse toxic spores that cause dizziness and nausea.
appearance: A sickly green fly with compound eyes that ooze purple liquid. Its wings have a toxic sheen, and its body is covered in pustules.

name: Plaguewing
description: Plaguewing was responsible for several historical pandemics. Its presence causes plants to wilt and water to become undrinkable.
appearance: A large, menacing fly with tattered wings dripping with venom. Its segmented body pulses with sickly bioluminescence, and a cloud of miasma surrounds it.

name: Shroombud
description: Shroombud grows in dark, damp caves. It releases spores when startled that cause vivid hallucinations.
appearance: A tiny mushroom hollowing with a spotted red and white cap. Two beady eyes peek out from under the cap, and small root-like feet allow it to waddle around.

name: Fungrowth
description: Fungrowth's network of underground mycelium can span entire forests. It shares nutrients with other plants in exchange for spreading its spores.
appearance: A medium-sized mushroom with a purple-spotted cap and multiple smaller mushrooms growing from its body. Glowing spores constantly drift from its gills.

name: Sporecrown
description: Sporecrown is the apex of fungal evolution. Its cap resembles a king's crown, and entire ecosystems depend on its mycelium network for survival.
appearance: A regal mushroom hollowing with a golden crown-shaped cap adorned with bioluminescent spots. Its body is thick and trunk-like, with smaller symbiotic fungi growing in patterns like royal robes.

name: Whispling
description: Whispling is born from the last breath of dying hollowings. It drifts on wind currents, carrying faint memories of lives long past.
appearance: A wispy, translucent hollowing that resembles a small cloud with two hollow eyes. Faint faces of the departed occasionally appear and fade within its misty form.

name: Phantgale
description: Phantgale commands hurricane-force winds carrying the voices of thousands of spirits. Ships that hear its howl are never seen again.
appearance: A massive, swirling vortex of spectral energy with a central eye like a hurricane. Ghostly arms reach out from the storm, and tortured faces swirl within the winds.

name: Tindertail
description: Tindertail's bushy tail ignites when it feels strong emotions. It hoards shiny objects in nests lined with fire-resistant bark.
appearance: A small squirrel with russet fur and a magnificent tail that flickers with orange flames. Its cheeks are puffy with stored embers, and its eyes sparkle with mischief.

name: Shadowpup
description: Shadowpup lurks in the shadows of travelers, feeding on their fear. Despite its sinister nature, it's fiercely loyal to those who befriend it.
appearance: A small, wolf-like hollowing made of living shadow. Only its glowing red eyes and white fangs are clearly visible. Wisps of darkness trail from its form.

name: Duskhound
description: Duskhound hunts in packs during moonless nights. Its howl can extinguish fires and plunge areas into supernatural darkness.
appearance: A sleek, muscular wolf composed of solidified shadow. Dark smoke billows from its fur, and its eyes glow like dying embers. Sharp bone-like protrusions extend from its shoulders.

name: Nighterror
description: Nighterror is said to be the physical manifestation of nightmares. It can enter dreams and trap victims in endless loops of their worst fears.
appearance: A massive, three-headed wolf beast wreathed in black flames. Each head has different glowing eyes—red, purple, and white. Its body seems to absorb light itself, and spectral chains drag behind it.

name: Glimmoth
description: Glimmoth's wings scatter light into rainbow patterns. It's drawn to sources of illumination and often gathers around street lamps.
appearance: A delicate moth with wings that shimmer like stained glass. Its body glows with soft golden light, and its feathery antennae detect the faintest photons.

name: Radianthra
description: Radianthra's wings can focus light into devastating beams. Ancient texts describe it guiding lost travelers through darkness with its luminous trail.
appearance: A magnificent moth with enormous wings that display shifting aurora patterns. Its body radiates warm light like a miniature sun, and prismatic dust falls from its wings as it flies.

name: Coglin
description: Coglin was accidentally created when scrap metal gained sentience near a power plant. It constantly seeks spare parts to add to its body.
appearance: A small, goblin-like hollowing made of mismatched gears, springs, and metal plates. Its eyes are old lightbulbs that flicker, and steam occasionally vents from its joints.

name: Mechagrin
description: Mechagrin's body runs on an internal combustion engine. It can reshape its limbs into various tools and weapons at will.
appearance: A hulking mechanical humanoid with a furnace in its chest and smokestacks on its shoulders. Its face is a permanent metallic grin, and its arms can transform into hammers, drills, or claws.

name: Embercub
description: Embercub's fur smolders with internal heat. Mother bears teach their cubs to control their flames by having them light campfires for travelers.
appearance: A chubby bear cub with orange-red fur that glows at the tips. Tiny flames flicker from its rounded ears, and its paw pads leave scorched footprints.

name: Flamebear
description: Flamebear marks its territory by scorching trees with its claws. It can hibernate for months, sustained entirely by its internal flame.
appearance: A muscular bear with deep crimson fur and a mane of flames around its neck. Its claws glow white-hot, and smoke rises from its nostrils with each breath.

name: Infernursus
description: Infernursus's roar can trigger volcanic eruptions. Ancient legends say it shaped the world's mountains by clawing through the earth's crust.
appearance: A colossal bear wreathed in flames and magma. Its fur is made of cooling volcanic rock with rivers of lava flowing through cracks. Its eyes burn like twin suns, and each step causes minor tremors.

name: Glacimite
description: Glacimite forms in frozen caves where iron deposits meet eternal ice. Its body is so cold that it can freeze water vapor into metal-hard crystals.
appearance: A crystalline hollowing with a body of blue ice interlaced with silvery metal veins. Sharp icicles protrude from its back like spines, and frost constantly emanates from its core.

name: Lumikid
description: Lumikid appears to children who are lost or afraid, guiding them to safety with its gentle glow. It giggles with a sound like chiming bells.
appearance: A small, cherubic hollowing with pale golden skin that radiates soft light. Its eyes are large and kind, and small wings of pure light flutter behind it. A halo-like glow crowns its head.

name: Volteel
description: Volteel generates electricity through specialized organs along its body. Fishermen fear and respect it, as one touch can power a boat—or destroy it.
appearance: A long, serpentine eel with deep blue scales and yellow lightning-bolt patterns. Electricity arcs between its fins, and its eyes glow with an electric blue light.

name: Ironhide
description: Ironhide's shell is harder than diamond. It curls into a ball and rolls through mountains, carving tunnels that become homes for other hollowings.
appearance: A massive armadillo-like hollowing covered in overlapping plates of dark gray metal. Its claws are reinforced for digging, and its eyes peek out from narrow slits in its armored face.

name: Snochi
description: A small, timid hollowing that hides in thick snow. It uses its long ears to sense vibrations of approaching predators.
appearance: A tiny, white rabbit-like Pokémon with fur that sparkles like fresh powder and large, blue-tipped ears.
evolution_mechanic: Evolves when it reaches level 16 in cold environments.

name: Snoven
description: Snoven is the turning point of its line. Depending on the environment it trains in, it adapts its fur to either endure or strike.
appearance: A medium-sized hare with thick, insulating ruffs of fur around its neck and paws that have developed small, sharp ice-claws.
evolution_mechanic: Evolves at level 34. Path depends on environment conditions during evolution.

name: Glacimal
description: When Snoven evolves in a blizzard, it loses its physical form to the wind, becoming a haunting spirit of the cold.
appearance: A large, spectral white hare that appears to be made of swirling snow-mist. Its eyes glow with a chilling blue light.

name: Harefrost
description: By bonding with metallic ores, Snoven's fur becomes as hard as steel, turning it into a living battering ram.
appearance: A muscular, armored hare. Its ears have become heavy metallic blades and its fur has a polished, silvery sheen.

name: Sparkle
description: A small spark of energy that lives in power lines. It is highly erratic and difficult to catch.
appearance: A floating yellow mote of light with tiny, crackling electricity arms and a joyful face.
evolution_mechanic: Evolves at level 20. Path depends on which stat is higher - Speed or Defense.

name: Voltwing
description: It uses its wings to generate massive amounts of static electricity as it flies through storm clouds.
appearance: A sleek, bird-like hollowing made of yellow lightning with translucent, cloud-like wings.
evolution_mechanic: Evolves when it reaches level 40 and masters storm magic.

name: Stormlord
description: It commands the weather itself. A single beat of its wings can trigger a week-long thunderstorm.
appearance: A massive, four-winged thunderbird with eyes that flash like lightning and a tail of dark storm clouds.

name: Currenshell
description: It has encased itself in a heavy copper shell that conducts its electrical energy efficiently.
appearance: A tortoise-like Pokémon with a shell made of copper coils and a head that looks like a lightbulb.
evolution_mechanic: Evolves when it reaches level 40 after storing sufficient electrical charge.

name: Ohm-Titan
description: It acts as a living battery. Cities sometimes use Ohm-Titans to restart power grids after a collapse.
appearance: A colossal, bipedal machine-like hollowing with massive Tesla coils on its back and a body of reinforced steel.

name: Glub
description: A simple fish Pokémon found in almost every body of water. It is the favorite food of many larger species.
appearance: A round, blue fish with big, vacant eyes and a perpetually open mouth.
evolution_mechanic: Evolves when it reaches level 20 and grows larger.

name: Glub-Glub
description: It has grown larger and more aggressive. It can swallow water and spit it out like a high-pressure jet.
appearance: A larger, slightly grumpier fish with more defined fins and a sturdy jaw.
evolution_mechanic: Evolves at level 38. Path depends on environmental conditions - darkness or freezing temperatures.

name: Glub-Abyss
description: An evolution found in the deepest trenches. It uses its bioluminescent teeth to lure in unsuspecting prey.
appearance: A terrifying, deep-sea angler fish with pitch-black scales and a glowing red lure.

name: Glub-Arctic
description: It has adapted to the freezing waters of the poles. Its body is so cold that the water around it turns to slush.
appearance: A majestic, crystalline fish with fins that look like jagged icicles and scales that shimmer like frost.

name: Icipillar
description: It feeds on frozen berries and concentrates their toxins into its hair-like spines.
appearance: A fuzzy, light-blue caterpillar with purple poisonous spikes along its back.
evolution_mechanic: Evolves when it reaches level 12 and forms an icy cocoon.

name: Frostsalis
description: It hangs from the underside of frozen branches, waiting for the right temperature to emerge.
appearance: A hard, translucent cocoon made of ice and purple venom. It is nearly impossible to break.
evolution_mechanic: Evolves at level 30. Path depends on gender - females become graceful moths while males become venomous hunters.

name: Moth-Frost
description: A beautiful moth that spreads freezing scales from its wings. It can stop a waterfall just by flying over it.
appearance: A delicate moth with enormous, snowflake-patterned wings and long, feathery antennae.

name: Venom-Glaze
description: Its wings are coated in a specialized neurotoxin that freezes the muscles of anything it touches.
appearance: A sleek, predatory insect with sharp, needle-like wings and glowing purple veins.

name: Petal
description: It mimics a real flower to avoid being eaten. It smells like sweet nectar.
appearance: A small green seedling with a single, large pink petal on its head like a hat.
evolution_mechanic: Evolves when it reaches level 18 and begins to bloom.

name: Bloom-Bud
description: Depending on the time of day it evolves, its bloom will either harness the sun or the moon.
appearance: A slender plant with several tightly closed flower buds around its neck.
evolution_mechanic: Evolves when exposed to a Sun Stone or Moon Stone, determining which celestial power it harnesses.

name: Sun-Bather
description: It absorbs sunlight with its massive petals, converting it into blinding beams of light.
appearance: A tall, sun-flower like hollowing with glowing golden petals and a body of vibrant green vines.

name: Moon-Dancer
description: It only blooms at night. Its fragrance is hypnotic and can put a whole village to sleep.
appearance: A dark purple lily-like Pokémon with petals that glow with a faint, silvery lunar light.

name: Solarius
description: Solarius is said to be a fragment of the sun itself given form. It appears during solar eclipses, and ancient civilizations built temples to honor its radiance.
appearance: A majestic phoenix-like hollowing with feathers of pure golden light and flames. A corona of solar fire surrounds its head like a crown, and its tail trails ribbons of plasma. Its eyes hold the intensity of a star.

name: Lumidrake
description: Lumidrake channels the brilliance of dawn, bringing order and clarity where chaos reigns. Legends say its presence banishes all deceit and shadow.
appearance: Sleek and radiant dragon with opalescent scales that refract light like stained glass. Its wings shimmer in gold and silver as if woven from sunlight.

name: Umbradrake
description: Umbradrake commands the endless night, consuming all luminance to reveal truth through absence. Together with Lumidrake, it keeps the balance of creation and collapse.
appearance: A serpentine dragon cloaked in rippling shadow. Its scales look like broken shards of glass reflecting dim stars, and its red eyes cut through darkness.

name: Eclipserion
description: Eclipserion is the embodiment of endings — the stillness between light and shadow. Said to arise when Lumidrake and Umbradrake vanish, it governs the cycle’s pause with infinite calm.
appearance: A translucent dragon with a ring-like mane resembling an eclipse corona. Its body seems half-solid, phasing between physical and spectral states.
